verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own docs cover all three pillars in one platform. Spend is covered by corporate cards with authorization controls and card expenses (docs-2, 3, 4, 20, 30). Bill pay is covered by the Bills API and accounts payable, with transfers and batch supplier payments (docs-5, 6, 19, 30). Banking is covered by the business account, Global Accounts and multi-currency wallets (docs-17, 18, 21). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that founders actually consolidate tools onto it, and explicit documentation of the end-to-end bill-approval-to-payment flow rather than separate Bills and Transfers features.
